title: Laser-propelled flying-disc tests at Sandia and White Sands
place_text: Sandia National Lab and White Sands, New Mexico

plain: There is said to be a video of a disc being pushed into flight by a laser, in tests run at Sandia National Lab, a US government science and weapons lab in New Mexico, and at White Sands, a military test range in the same state. Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency (the US intelligence agency that intercepts communications), says he knows the man who did it: "we know the guy who did it at Sandia National Lab and White Sands where you take a disc." He tells it to show that humans have built flying discs of their own.
